là khu nghỉ dưỡng ven biển quy mô 8,6 ha: is an 8.6 ha seaside resort on Lac Long Quan Street, Dien Duong Commune, Dien Ban (formerly part of Quang Nam, now part of Da Nang City), next to An Bang Beach and only about 5 minutes from Hoi An Ancient Town.
